Palamu darshan- sugga bandh: prakriti, lokakthaen aur paharon ki khubsurat kahani | Nature, Culture & Tourism of Jharkhand | DD Jharkhand
Jharkhand ki pahchan sirph uske khanij aur udyogon se nahin, balki yahan ke ghane janglon, khubsurat pahariyon, jharnon, nadiyon aur samriddh loksanskriti se bhi hai. kya aapne kabhi aise prakritik sthal ki kalpana ki hai, jahan jharne ki aavaj, paharon ki hariyali aur lokakthaon ki mithas ek sath mahsus ki ja sake? jahan prakriti ke khubsurat najare ke sath sthaniy paranpraon aur janjivan ki kahaniyan bhi juri hon?
